name: learning-platform
description: Personal Learning Platform - Offline Udemy-Style Course Manager

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix electron
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix electron"
scripts.build:full: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test:api: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5000/api/courses').then(r => r.json()).then(d => console.log('✅ API Works:', d)).catch(e => console.error('❌ API Error:', e))"
scripts.test:health: node -e "fetch('http://localhost:5000/health').then(r => r.json()).then(d => console.log('✅ Health Check:', d)).catch(e => console.error('❌ Health Error:', e))"
